output: We can’t offer free storage for the full six months, but we can offer two weeks at no charge.
Before departure, enable offline mode while connected to Wi-Fi to download your selected route. Live detours are unavailable offline.
A workshop reservation holds your place but does not include materials; you can buy a kit for $18 or bring the items on the supply list. Buying a kit does not reserve a workshop place.
Keep the original receipt. A photo is acceptable for registration, but warranty claims require the paper copy.
Saturday’s outdoor screening may move indoors if the forecast remains unfavorable. The final location will be posted at noon Friday. Tickets remain valid at either location.
Run Preview before importing. It flags missing dates and duplicate order numbers without changing records. Fix all flagged rows in the source file, then select Import.
The replacement wheels are included in the shipment. The axle wasn’t part of the original order, but I’m happy to send a separate quote.
Apply for the discount if you live within city limits and either are 65 or older or have a current disability transit pass.

Your saved searches have moved to the new dashboard and are ready to open. Their alert settings have not yet moved, so continue changing those settings in the old dashboard. We expect to migrate alerts next week, subject to verification.

Staff may borrow a meeting-room key for a confirmed booking. Return it to reception before leaving the building. If reception is closed, use the locked key box beside its desk. Do not leave keys in the meeting room.

Open your invitation link within 48 hours. Choose a password, then enter the six-digit code sent to your email. If the invitation has expired, ask the inviter for a new link.

Administrators assign workspace access separately. You may log in successfully and still see an empty workspace list; contact an administrator for access.

The riverside route is open between Mill Bridge and the old ferry landing on the main gravel path. The lower boardwalk and the staircase from the landing to the water remain closed. Follow the entrance route map and temporary barriers; an open bridge gate does not mean every area is open. No schedule has been approved for the remaining repairs.

The path was inspected on April 12 and found suitable for ordinary spring conditions. Water levels can rise quickly during heavy rain, and the duty ranger may close it without notice. Check the entrance board: a closure notice takes priority over an earlier reopening post.

Access and toilets

Wheelchair users and visitors with strollers can reach the picnic area from Mill Bridge without steps. Beyond it, a short section has loose gravel and a steep cross-slope. The full route has not yet had a completed accessibility assessment.

The accessible toilet in the bridge car park is open from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. The ferry landing toilet is closed.

Dogs and bicycles

Dogs are welcome on the open path on a lead. From March 1 through July 31, dogs are excluded from the marked nesting zone beside the reed beds, even on a lead. You may still walk your dog along the main path beside the zone.

Cycling is allowed from Mill Bridge to the picnic area, with pedestrians taking priority. Beyond the picnic area, dismount and walk your bicycle to the ferry landing. This applies to conventional and electric bicycles; mobility aids are exempt.

Parking

Mill Bridge parking costs $3 for up to two hours or $5 for the day. Machines accept cards only. There is no separate walking admission fee, and visitors arriving on foot do not need a parking ticket.

Optional guided walk

A local volunteer group offers a free guided walk at 10 a.m. on the first Sunday of each month. Registration is required, with a limit of twelve people. Registration reserves your walk place but does not reserve parking or waive its charge.

From September 1, submit photographic collection requests through the collection portal. Email requests received before September 1 will keep their place in the existing queue; do not resubmit them. Later email requests will receive portal instructions. If you cannot use the portal, staff can help you complete a request by phone.

Include your contact details, a brief research purpose, and the collection reference if you know it. If you do not, provide as much descriptive information as possible; a reference is not required.

Staff first check for an existing usable scan. These normally take up to five working days to supply after the item is identified. New scans have no fixed turnaround during the conservation backlog.

Access and conservation

The conservation team decides whether an original can be handled safely. If scanning would risk damage, the collections team will explain any available alternatives, such as an older reference image, a catalog description, or supervised viewing. Alternatives depend on the item’s condition and restrictions and are not guaranteed. Where possible, staff will explain the specific reason for a refusal.

Privacy review

Requests containing personal information about living people may need additional review before access is granted. Privacy, conservation, and rights checks are separate: clearing one does not clear the others. No deadline has been promised for additional reviews.

Charges

Reference scans are free for individual research requests of up to ten images. Larger requests are reviewed for staffing time and may incur a quoted service charge. You must accept the quote before chargeable work begins. The threshold applies to the total request, so splitting a project across submissions does not automatically provide additional free allowances. Staff may ask about related requests to establish the total.

Publication and rights

Receiving a reference scan for private study does not grant permission to publish it in a book, website, exhibition, or commercial product. The process does not change ownership of the photographs. You are responsible for obtaining any necessary publication permissions, and the museum can grant permission only for rights it controls.

Catalog rights information is incomplete. “No rights holder recorded” means the museum has no holder listed; it does not establish that an image is in the public domain. Staff can share recorded information but cannot promise to identify every rights holder. Paying for scanning does not buy a publication license or transfer copyright.

The east lift is out of service after stopping between floors at 8:10 a.m. with two passengers inside. At 8:27 a.m., the service team opened the doors, and both passengers left without reported injury.

A worn door sensor was found and a replacement is on order, but the cause of the stoppage has not been confirmed. Checks must be completed before the lift returns to service; a reopening date is not yet available. The west lift remains available.

Delivery on October 4 is unconfirmed. Operations says delivery is booked for that date, but the supplier portal checked later lists estimated dispatch on October 4 with delivery pending. The purchase order says the delivery date is to be agreed. These sources do not establish when the order will arrive.

Hold off on scheduling installers for October 5. Ask Operations and the supplier to reconcile the booking and confirm the delivery date in writing before committing to installation.

We recommend keeping the weekday shuttle through November, subject to budget committee approval. Average weekday ridership was 42 in September and 39 in October, and the shuttle serves the clinic on Tuesdays when no public bus is available.

Weekend ridership was not measured, so these data do not support extending weekend service. We propose counting weekend riders for four weeks before deciding.

No duplicate imports were found, so the evidence does not support my earlier suspicion. A timezone filter excludes seven rows; I’m comparing stored timestamps with the filter boundaries to find out why.
Four of the five brochures are converted. Three have passed keyboard checks; I’m checking the fourth next, then converting the fifth.
Rendering revealed broken page numbering. I’m fixing it locally and will check the rendered handbook before requesting your approval to upload.
Fixed the Safari-only focus problem locally. Keyboard checks pass in Safari and Firefox, and all 38 automated tests pass. The changes have not been committed, pushed, or deployed.

I missed the 3 p.m. deadline—sorry. The main report summary is drafted, but two conflicting appendix totals are blocking the financial comparison. I’m comparing the appendix calculations to reconcile them.

Choose Cedar: at $18/month, it supports the five editors you need. Birch costs $12/month but allows only one editor. Pine’s price and editor limit are unavailable, so its suitability and value remain unresolved.
Our records show the projector was returned late, so a $25 late fee applies. If the return record is incorrect, please send your drop-off receipt by Friday.
The new office kettle is here after an unnecessarily elaborate procurement journey. It boils water. We have tested this revolutionary capability. Please empty it before the weekend.
Sports day is Thursday, May 16, not Wednesday as stated in yesterday’s newsletter. The start time remains 9 a.m. Sorry for the error.
I don’t know the right thing to say. I loved how your dad always made room at the table. I can bring dinner Thursday, if that would help.
This clay pot kept food cooler without electricity. Water seeped through tiny pores in the clay. As it evaporated, it carried heat away from the pot and the food inside.

The three primary buttons have the same color and size, and testers repeatedly chose Cancel instead of Save. Give Save a distinct filled color and make Cancel a neutral outline button so the actions are easier to tell apart.
We’ve got a queue this morning, folks. If you’re just dropping off a form, pop it in the blue tray and you’re good to go. Payments still need the counter.

The new reminder subject line got 41 opens out of 100, compared with 44 for the old line. We haven’t run a statistical analysis, so this doesn’t establish a meaningful difference. We’ll keep the old line for now and test a different send time next week.
The reduced rate applies to stays of 3–6 nights. Seven-night bookings use the weekly rate; two-night bookings use the standard rate.
Editors can propose changes, but only owners can approve publication. Approval covers that version only; it does not cover future versions or changes to who has access.

Lab A reported 12 mg/L and Lab B reported 19 mg/L. Because the samples were collected on different dates using different methods, and no method comparison is available, these results cannot establish a change over time or show that either measurement is wrong.
Restart the pump only when the inlet valve is open and the pressure gauge reads below 20 psi. If either condition is not met, do not restart it; call the supervisor.

Enrollment lets you request a travel grant but does not guarantee an award. Awards depend on available funds and approval of your proposed trip. Booking before approval does not increase your priority.

Outages fell from 10 in the month before the maintenance change to 6 in the month after. This does not establish that maintenance caused the decline: weather was milder in the second month, and usage was not recorded.
We will replace defective stitching reported within one year of purchase. This guarantee excludes fabric fading, accidental damage, and normal wear. Keep proof of purchase.

Do not hire either candidate yet. Hiring requires both a passed practical test and two satisfactory references. Candidate A passed the test but still needs to supply two references for review. Candidate B supplied both references but failed the practical test; their references also have not been confirmed satisfactory.
